GET /api/basic-auth/check.note: Checks the Basic gate and issues its cookie when Basic credentials are supplied.

GET /api/exploration/activity/stream.note: SSE. Query task and since; also supports Last-Event-ID.

GET /api/logs/stream.note: SSE. Resume via query since from the last event's data.seq.

GET /api/side-questions/{requestID}/even.note: SSE snapshots. A reconnect may replay the current snapshot.

GET /api/update/stream.note: SSE for Web binary update progress.

POST /api/chat.note: JSON {message, attachments?, seg?}; optional query task. Live task activity uses the separate activity stream.

POST /api/chat/upload.note: Query scope=task|session|staging and id; multipart field file may repeat.

POST /api/skills/upload.note: One ZIP in multipart field file; optional overwrite=true.

POST /api/tasks.note: JSON with description, goal, and optional name, company_ids, llm_profile_ids, timeout_seconds, intercept_rules and schedule.

POST /api/update/apply.note: Applies the Web binary update. It does not replace the Docker image.

POST /api/workspace/upload.note: Query path is the destination directory; multipart field file may repeat.
